name: Aegis Institute
aliases: Aegis Allied Force / Aegis Alliance Unit (its joint combat force)
sideNote: Founded by the Counter-Terrorism Alliance, but has maintained a deliberately neutral position between Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists so that both can run joint anti-zombie operations.
summary: The Aegis Institute is the zombie-research and anti-zombie-weapons institute at the heart of Counter-Strike Online's Zombie Scenario storyline. Established by the Counter-Terrorism Alliance once it became clear Dr. Rex's research would not reduce the zombie threat, it gathers top scientists and weapons experts from many countries, arms the Zombie Extermination Squadron, and searches for a cure for the Zombie Virus. Its best-known face is Senior Researcher Soy (Ahn Soi), the voice guiding players through most scenario chapters.
description: The Counter-Terrorism Alliance created the Aegis Research Center to develop specialised anti-zombie weapons and to study zombies, at the same time organising a separate zombie-extermination unit to declare war on the undead. The institute's staff are excellent scientists and researchers from each country who combine scientific knowledge with deep weapons expertise; they manufacture weapons for the Zombie Extermination Squadron while trying to cure the Zombie Virus. Its neutrality between CT and TR laid the groundwork for the two sides to carry out missions together - most notably large-scale joint operations built on the close friendship of David Black (AFC) and Gerard (PMC). A mysterious 'Doctor A' is said to be secretly aiding the counter-terrorism coalition.
lore:
**Campaign role.** The Institute frames the Season 2 pursuit of Dione: one year after the Lost City incident, Senior Researcher Soy briefs the LS team over the Caribbean (Toxicity) to search for clues about Dr. Rex, then orders the wounded Dione captured or killed (Culvert). Later, the Institute's secret communication base is discovered by Kronos, which sends zombies and mass-produced AMP Suits / Mad Mechanics to destroy it (Cordon). After Alin and Dominique blow up a Kronos secret lab and expose Kronos's facilities, Douglas Jacob strikes back and captures the Aegis laboratories; Jennifer and Dr. Soi arm themselves to retake them (Obstacle). With heroes and super soldiers engaged elsewhere, the government forms a special relief force to rescue survivors in isolated cities (Convoy). In the finale, the Aegis Allied Force storms Douglas Jacob's hideout and Soi calls in the airstrike that kills him.

**Zombie classification.** Aegis has classified several notable zombies after first contact - e.g. Ganymede, categorised as a Siege Type Deimos: high HP, agile, able to slip past bullets and rush enemies at great speed. Other classified samples include Frozen Terror's Mane and Gluttony's Tongue.

**Discontinued special missions.** 'Collect Hero's Information' (win 3 rounds as Hero in Zombie Hero mode), 'Morale Boost Experience', 'Airstrike Support'.

leaders: Soy (Ahn Soi) - Senior Researcher / founder-figure of the Institute; later 'Leader Soi'
members: Doctor A (identity unknown; rumoured secret ally)

trivia: In Greek mythology the Aegis is the shield or breastplate of Athena or Zeus, said to withstand anything.
Super Soldier Jennifer is the only known Aegis personnel who uses enemy weapons and equipment.
